commands.name: CreateObjectiveFromPreview
steps: inside UoW revalidate every existing Task current plan/lock/unassigned state and exact global envelope nonoverlap
validate draft Local Tasks/plan conversions and affected LLD-03 references
allocate objective_id and non-reusable MW-########
insert receipt
create any draft Local Tasks and their plan revisions
insert Objective and one membership per member pinned to exact accepted plan revision
append membership events/rebuild envelope+aggregate projections
audit exact member/result refs and commit
rules: if overlap now exists return stale/overlap and require regroup preview; never create overlapping Objective

commands.name: CancelObjectiveBeforeExecution
steps: inside UoW load every current member and prove no accepted Task start exists
require no protected state makes bulk cancellation ambiguous
insert receipt
for each unstarted member append manual_cancel execution + reviewed cancelled_without_execution outcome events
rebuild projections
append Objective review event from exact current fingerprint with derived_outcome=cancelled
audit result refs and commit
rules: one started Task blocks whole-Objective Cancelled

commands.name: ReviewObjective
steps: inside UoW require current nonsuperseded non-historical Objective and every current member has independently accepted outcome
derive aggregate solely from Task outcomes/inclusion
insert receipt and objective_review_event using server reviewed_at
rebuild aggregate as reviewed/current and audit
commit
rules: does not write execution times or Task outcomes
later Task outcome/membership/inclusion correction invalidates currentness by fingerprint without editing review event

commands.name: ArchiveObjective
steps: inside UoW reject hiding active unfinished safety state unless its work remains forced-visible by projection; normal eligibility requires reviewed/cancelled/historical/superseded state
insert receipt/archive event/update archive projection
audit and commit
commands.rule: archive changes presentation only; Task/membership/execution/source history unchanged

commands.name: RestoreObjective
steps: inside UoW require currently archived
insert receipt/restore event/update projection
audit and commit

commands.name: SetObjectiveTimezone
steps: resolve exact IANA name offline before lock
preview proves presentation-only effect
inside UoW call LLD-02 typed SettingStore for OBJECTIVE_TIMEZONE_V1 using same command context
insert required audit through owning command envelope and commit
rules: does not rewrite Task plan/execution/source/report instants
preserving existing wall-clock labels under new zone requires separate explicit Task plan reschedule/correction

commands.name: HardDeleteObjective
steps: inside UoW require creation_origin=manual, no execution/outcome/review/archive/historical/supersession/regroup-protected history and exact previewed current members/relationships
require each dependent membership removal is draft-safe and Tasks themselves remain valid outside Objective unless separately deleted
insert receipt
remove eligible membership/current projection/objective rows atomically
audit Objective deletion and retained Task ids then commit
commands.rule: automatic-grouping/historical Objectives and history-bearing Objectives are not hard-deletable; this narrow path exists only to preserve persisted-objective nonempty invariant when an untouched manual Objective is discarded

pure_preview_authority: ObjectiveCreationPreview and ObjectiveHardDeletePreview are defined in queries/objectives-tasks.json. They are side-effect-free snapshot reads and create no command receipt, revision, audit event, proposal row or external effect.
